remaining.title: Let link-holders clear checked items and delete rows (fix #7, the rules half)
remaining.why: The controls are gated by apps/signup-sheets/firestore.rules — the entries delete rule allows only the author or the owner, and the board update rule allows only owners to move entryCount downward, for a documented anti-abuse reason ('a hostile client could drain the counter and bypass the 500-entry cap'). That file is outside apps/grocery-list/. I shipped the review's stated minimum instead: the UI now explains the limit rather than silently omitting the controls.

remaining.title: Refund the entry quota when a participant deletes their own row
remaining.why: Same rules constraint: participant board updates are increment-only by design. The owner path is fixed and clearChecked() still resets the counter for everybody's rows, so a household is no longer on a one-way trip to the cap — but a participant's ✕ still costs a slot until the owner clears.

remaining.title: Quantity, notes and aisle sections
remaining.why: Named in Dee's frictions and in mostWantedNext, but deliberately not in the ordered `fixes` array — it is a data-model change (entry shape, rules `hasOnly` key list, migration for existing rows) rather than a fix, and half of it would be worse than none.

remaining.title: Owner rename of the list title
remaining.why: b.title is now shown on the board, in print and in the share panel, which is what fix #12 was actually about. Renaming needs an editing affordance and a rules-shaped updateBoard call; it is additive and did not fit the round without rushing it.

remaining.title: A collapsed 'In the cart (n)' group below a divider
remaining.why: Fix #2 offered this as the better of two options, but any automatic regroup reintroduces the exact blocker: the row moves out from under the finger. I took the option that cannot regress — one list, one stable order, done rows styled in place — and put an 'N items in the cart' summary below the rows where a change cannot push them around. Measured 0px row movement per tick; a grouped variant measured 28px before I moved the summary below the list.
